unauthorized_categories: arbitrary web browsing beyond the allowlist
git protocol endpoints (no git-lfs clone; HTTPS range GETs only)

cost.expected_storage_cost: local disk only; peak 45.40 GiB across all eight candidates
cost.policy: EXPECTED_ACQUISITION_COST = 0. Any artifact requiring payment stops with PAID_ACCESS_REQUIRES_NEW_FOUNDER_DECISION. No paid Colab, no rented GPU, no inference API.

retention_cleanup.retention_policy: Artifacts persist in the external acquisition directory through T028-T034 qualification; after T034 closes, candidates absent from its admission decision are deletable on founder approval.
retention_cleanup.cleanup_policy: Partial downloads are deleted on first failure; verified artifacts are immutable (re-download rather than patch); cleanup actions are logged in evidence.
retention_cleanup.cache_policy: No provider cache population; direct-to-final streaming keeps peak storage equal to final storage.
retention_cleanup.artifact_location_policy: Binaries under gitignored artifacts/external/<candidate_id>/; only manifests, hashes, and evidence enter Git.
retention_cleanup.git_exclusion_summary: .gitignore already blocks models/, weights/, downloads/, data/raw/, artifacts/external/, artifacts/tmp/, *.safetensors, *.gguf, *.pt, *.pth, *.onnx.

git_exclusion.verification: T028 must run `git status --ignored` after acquisition and assert zero untracked weight files; a violation fails T028 closed.

proposed_t028_authority_envelope.stays_blocked_until: Separate explicit founder authorization naming manifest id T027-weight-access-preflight-frozen and the approved candidate subset.
explicitly_required_for: HTTPS GET of exactly the required_artifact_files listed per approved candidate
what_T028_does: stream-download pinned artifacts over the declared host allowlist
record acquisition outcome per candidate (acquired / EXCLUDED_*)
what_T028_does_not: run any model, quantizer, runtime, or training step
install Unsloth or open Colab sessions
fetch revisions not listed in this manifest
grant backbone, finalist, or local_qualified status (T034/T050/T055)
proposed_t028_authority_envelope.post_T028_does_not_automatically_open: Completing T028 opens nothing beyond recording acquisition evidence; T029 quantization profile work remains separate with its own scope.

unresolved_risks: Candidates ministral-3-3b, granite-4.1-3b, smollm3-3b, and yi-coder-1.5b lack a standalone LICENSE text file at their pinned revisions; rights rest on consistent machine-readable tag plus explicit README declarations at the same revision. Mitigation: preserve each README as the notice artifact and re-check before any redistribution.

Aggregate download/final footprint ~45.4 GiB exceeds single-laptop comfort for some machines; the founder may approve a bounded subset at T028 time — this manifest permits subset selection without editing candidate entries.
Qwen3.5 family ships vision-encoder weights inside the same shards; text-only serving validation is deferred to runtime qualification (T030), not resolved here.
CDN redirect targets are documented from current observation but may evolve upstream; T028 must pin observed redirect hosts in its own evidence before downloading.
